scripts.examples:update: pnpm --filter s11tnext-example-minimal build && pnpm --filter s11tnext-example-node-basic build && pnpm --filter s11tnext-example-rag-e2e-fixture build
scripts.test:examples: pnpm --filter s11tnext-example-minimal check && pnpm --filter s11tnext-example-node-basic check && pnpm --filter s11tnext-example-rag-e2e-fixture check
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-package-versions.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only && pnpm api:report && pnpm examples:update
scripts.version:canary: changeset version --snapshot canary && node scripts/sync-package-versions.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.test:packages: pnpm pack:all && pnpm test:package-contents && pnpm test:consumer && pnpm test:package-contracts
scripts.governance:plan:npm-trust: npx --yes npm@11.19.0 trust github s11tnext --file release.yml --repo ugnoguchigxp/s11tnext --allow-publish --dry-run --json && npx --yes npm@11.19.0 trust github s11tnext-cli --file release.yml --repo ugnoguchigxp/s11tnext --allow-publish --dry-run --json
scripts.governance:audit:npm-trust: npx --yes npm@11.19.0 trust list s11tnext --json && npx --yes npm@11.19.0 trust list s11tnext-cli --json
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:versions && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:type-fixtures && pnpm test:no-node-builtins && pnpm test:browser-bundle && pnpm exec s11tnext --help
scripts.verify:repository: pnpm verify && pnpm test:examples && pnpm test:schema-drift && pnpm test:cross-node && pnpm test:packages && pnpm benchmark:check
